direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi has ended her father's call and turned back to Kasun. He notices that her manner has changed, without knowing what passed on the call.
direction.people: Kasun stands at frame right, facing Anudi off frame left. He wears a faded blue short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. His hands are empty below frame. A part of Anudi's phone-holding hand is visible at the edge of frame. Kasun's small smile gives way to quiet concern.

flow.text: Kasun holds Anudi's gaze as his smile settles and his brow gathers slightly.
His eyes dip briefly, then return to her. He presses his lips together lightly and releases them.
His brow relaxes as he keeps looking toward her. His lips remain closed.

direction.camera: A locked-off, shallow-focus close-up from the roadside oblique angle holds Kasun on frame right with negative space to the left.
direction.sound: Light rain on the roadside; no music.
